pa-topic-rules.txt:
Pennsylvania policy topic coding rules from reviewed examples and guideline excerpts:
- Assign the narrowest topic matching the bill summary's substantive subject. Use the specific action and affected area; statute title alone does not control.
- Public School Code provisions concerning agreements between school districts, tuition charges between districts, school finances, and school course offerings are elementary/secondary education (602). Targeted school science programs may be education finance/equipment support (607); school safety standards such as carbon monoxide alarms are environmental health/safety (708).
- Municipal and residual waste facility siting, host municipality agreements, waste benefit fees, incineration, recycling, and related moratoria concern solid/hazardous waste management (703).
- Freezing assets of criminal defendants and juror compensation are criminal justice procedure (1204); defining racketeering activity under Crimes and Offenses is crime and criminal code (1202). Offenses such as harassment/stalking are criminal offenses (1210); prisoner release and minimum terms are corrections (1205). Drug treatment or rehabilitation programs belong to substance abuse treatment (342).
- Unemployment compensation rates and amounts are employment compensation/policy (503), not macroeconomic unemployment (103). Public employee labor relations, dispute resolution, and retirement system provisions are public employee relations/benefits (2004).
- Professional licensure board appropriations and occupational licensing are professional licensing (1527). Continuing education requirements for insurance professionals can be education (601).
- State procurement organization and Department of General Services duties are government procurement (2008); Commonwealth agency fee provisions specific to the Department of State are its administration (2011). Legislature and election officer constitutional structure are also state government operations (2011/2012 as applicable).
- Hospital and medical cost monitoring is health care costs (322); payment arrangements for health care service contractors are health insurance (323). Acquired immune deficiency syndrome services under Public Welfare are public assistance/social services (331).
- County assessment error refunds and assessment appeals are local taxation/property assessment (2404). State tax code changes and general state tax rate changes are state taxation (107); inheritance tax exemptions are inheritance tax (1212).
- Liquor Code provisions about breweries and wineries are domestic commerce/liquor (1528). Safe deposit box company regulation is banking (1501).
- Unified retirement systems for Commonwealth and political subdivision employees are public employee retirement (2004). Department of Veterans' Affairs functions are veterans affairs (1609).
- Emergency service providers recognition is fire/emergency services (1209). A resolution about children's safety in public places maps to child welfare/safety (332).
- Urban Growth Authority creation, grants, bonds, and indebtedness referendum are community development/economic development (1403). State parks are parks and recreation/public lands (2101).
- When a study resolution specifies a regulated transportation sector, classify by the sector (e.g. common carriers/taxicabs: transportation, 1098).
